scientific_scope: R-source-level deterministic reconstruction of the 20-row per site sampling stage only. No original occupancy refit or field-effect inference.
study: Mizsei and Wenner (2025), Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15044115, CC BY 4.0

R_execution.source_code: Source pinned survreps.R only, not install or invoke hunviphab/unmarked
original_R_steps: site Q1 exclude kis-banyato and vadasz-turjan; Q2 filter ci intervention
preserve original native raw CSV row ID in extra audit-only column

endpoints_fixed_before_R_execution: number of source-positive site×species records in Q1/Q2
number and identities of source-positive site×species pairs lost in seed-123 sampled table
number of distinct native source rows sampled among each site's 20 pseudo-occasions
number of resulting repeated source-row positions
exact native row-ID mapping as replay evidence
comparison with conditional analytical expectation without treating seed realization as a confidence interval
fail_closed: Require exact native CSV SHA256 and upstream git blob hash
require exactly 27 Q1 and 13 Q2 sites with 20 sampled rows each and exact known source-positive totals
require every sampled source-row ID came from same cohort/site in verified raw file
Never auto-resolve two native same-ID conflicting rows
No retrospective seed search or replacement of seed 123
No original occupancy, AIC, treatment effect, or causal A/B/M claim
No modifications to frozen EOG-WF 3/31/3 denominator
